stories.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
stories.take: OpenAI is working on a new $30 billion raise at a $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of an IPO — a record private valuation if it lands.

stories.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
stories.take: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island; the agents invented games, mourned a lost ring, and eventually got better at their jobs.

stories.title: Introducing Machine Gods
stories.take: Platformer launches 'Machine Gods,' a manifesto for AI realism — neither doomer nor booster — plus a look at the PHP2Shell scramble.

stories.title: Sharp drops for AI stocks overwhelm markets worldwide as oil prices jump
stories.take: AI stocks fell sharply worldwide on datacenter and chip costs, dragging markets lower even as non-AI names held up and oil hit its highest since May.

stories.title: Moderna and Merck say their mRNA cancer vaccine cut death, recurrence by 42%
stories.take: Moderna and Merck say their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine cut melanoma death and recurrence by 42% in top-line trial results.

stories.title: Latest estimate for Starship launches required to support a Moon landing? 22.
stories.take: The latest estimate for a Starship Moon landing is 22 launches — the refueling chain, not the lander alone, is the hard part.

stories.title: Arc browser sunsets December 22 as The Browser Company doubles down on Dia
stories.take: Arc sunsets December 22 as The Browser Company doubles down on Dia — a beloved browser that never became a mass-market Chrome alternative.

stories.title: Switch 2 security takes a hit as hackers unlock homebrew access
stories.take: A userland exploit in a SmileBasic interpreter gives hackers homebrew access on Switch 2 — Nintendo's security wall takes its first real hit.

stories.title: Comcast loses more customers, claims other ISPs' cheap prices are "irrational"
stories.take: Comcast lost more customers, called rivals' cheap prices 'irrational,' and plans job cuts and more AI agents for a shrinking cable base.

stories.title: UN says we're going to blow past 1.5º warming, offers a "now what?" answer
stories.take: The UN now says 1.5°C is gone: the best case is an overshoot to 1.8°C paired with massive carbon removal.

stories.title: 333 Tor exit nodes hijacked to intercept SSH traffic and retrieve plaintext email
stories.take: For three days this month, 333 Tor exit nodes were hijacked to intercept SSH traffic and pull plaintext email.

stories.title: Omnicom Nabs Coca-Cola’s North America Media Account While WPP Retains Globally
stories.take: Coca-Cola moves its North America media to Omnicom after Publicis resigned the business for PepsiCo; WPP keeps the global remit.

stories.title: Omnicom said its integration of IPG is nearly done, and the results are starting to show it
stories.take: Omnicom says the IPG integration is nearly done, with organic growth and margins starting to show the payoff, CEO John Wren told Digiday.

stories.title: Warner Bros. stirs up ‘The Cat in the Hat’ mayhem on Roblox ahead of film
stories.take: Warner Bros. is seeding 'The Cat in the Hat' inside Roblox ahead of the film, with playable items and limited avatar unlocks.

stories.title: Banana Republic debuts TikTok content series in bid for younger shoppers
stories.take: Banana Republic debuts a TikTok content series aimed at younger shoppers as Gap Inc. leans harder into entertainment marketing.

stories.title: How AB InBev built a culture of creative effectiveness that drives growth
stories.take: At ANA Masters, AB InBev's global CMO Marcel Marcondes explained the shift from advertiser to provider of experiences — creative effectiveness as a culture, not a campaign.

stories.title: Apple Music's splashy new logo is gorgeous – so why isn't the new app icon?
stories.take: Apple Music's new visual identity is gorgeous, Creative Bloq says — which makes the flat new app icon the odd one out.

stories.title: Dispatch's new Deluxe Edition lets you play the whole game as storyboard animatics
stories.take: Dispatch's Deluxe Edition adds a Storyboard Mode that plays the whole game as its original rough animatics, plus a commentary mode for its anniversary.

stories.title: Walmart Connect pitches brands directly as it pushes lift studies ahead of holiday ad deals
stories.take: Walmart Connect is pitching brands directly with lift studies ahead of the holidays — a tighter race with Amazon for retail media dollars.

stories.title: Co-defendant denies Billups gave him info, pleads guilty in NBA gambling case
stories.take: Eric Earnest pleaded guilty to wire-fraud conspiracy in the NBA gambling case but denied Chauncey Billups gave him inside information.

stories.title: Emotional Haliburton leads Pacers' gritty win in long-awaited return from Achilles tear
stories.take: An emotional Tyrese Haliburton returned from the Achilles tear he suffered in Game 7 of the 2025 Finals and led Indiana to a gritty opening win over New Orleans.

stories.title: Luka: Lakers' 'ceiling is even higher,' pairs with Kessler for blowout
stories.take: Luka Dončić, now the Lakers' face, paired with Walker Kessler in a 127-105 blowout of Golden State and said the ceiling is even higher.

stories.title: Clippers dedicate opening win over Kings to banned Ballmer
stories.take: The Clippers routed Sacramento 121-96 and dedicated the win to banned owner Steve Ballmer — Ty Lue: 'We're still fighting for him.'

stories.title: Giannis says new-look Heat 'got to trust each other more' after blowout loss
stories.take: After a blowout opening loss to Minnesota, Giannis said his new-look Heat have to trust each other more — a bumpy start in Miami.

stories.title: After igniting Anthony Edwards with trash talk, Heat reserve Myron Gardner advised by coach to 'be better'
stories.take: Heat reserve Myron Gardner lit up Anthony Edwards with trash talk; Erik Spoelstra loves the spirit but told him to be better.

stories.title: Victor Wembanyama on his dismal opening night performance vs. OKC: 'This is not the sport I like right here'
stories.take: Wembanyama went 1-for-13 on opening night against OKC and said he needs to think less: 'This is not the sport I like right here.'

stories.title: Rays opt for Martinez to start World Series over ace Rasmussen
stories.take: In a curveball, Tampa Bay starts Nick Martinez, not ace Drew Rasmussen, in World Series Game 1 Friday in Milwaukee against Jacob Misiorowski.

stories.title: On the biggest stage, Junior Caminero and Jackson Chourio are emerging as national superstars
stories.take: Junior Caminero and Jackson Chourio, two of the youngest stars on the Rays and Brewers, are ready for the World Series spotlight, teammates say.

stories.title: 2026 World Series odds, prediction: Full Fall Classic preview for Brewers vs. Rays starting Friday, Oct. 23
stories.take: Full preview for Brewers vs. Rays starting Friday: two No. 1 seeds, and one franchise leaves with its first title.

stories.title: Wait till this year! Just how rare a World Series between teams that have never won really is
stories.take: Brewers or Rays will celebrate a first title at the final out — ESPN dives into how rare a never-won World Series really is.

stories.title: Ohtani won't require surgery; Dodgers 'fully expect him to pitch next year'
stories.take: Shohei Ohtani will not need surgery, and the Dodgers 'fully expect him to pitch next year,' Andrew Friedman said.

stories.title: Vogt shuns Mariners rumors, says he'll manage Guardians in '27
stories.take: Stephen Vogt shut down Mariners rumors and said he'll manage Cleveland in 2027, chasing the title that keeps eluding the Guardians.

stories.title: Two umps to make World Series debuts in crew headed by Hoye
stories.take: Nic Lentz and Gabe Morales make their World Series umpiring debuts in a crew headed by James Hoye for Brewers–Rays.

stories.title: Trump, Musk, Zelenskyy: who is blaming who in the Ukraine-Starlink row?
stories.take: Trump claims Musk restored Ukraine's Starshield access, Kyiv and Musk trade blame over the restrictions, and no one will say who spoke to whom — a war of words over the link Ukraine fights on.

stories.title: Department of Justice opens criminal investigation into Corey Lewandowski
stories.take: The Justice Department opened a criminal investigation into Corey Lewandowski, the former Trump adviser and DHS aide alleged to have profited from his government role.

stories.title: RFK Jr. adviser Calley Means resigns amid growing MAHA discontent over lack of progress
stories.take: Calley Means, a top RFK Jr. adviser and MAHA advocate, resigned Thursday amid growing discontent in the movement over lack of progress.

stories.title: Iran says 7 oil tankers damaged in Strait of Hormuz, and other Middle East news
stories.take: Iran says seven oil tankers were damaged by mines or fire in the Strait of Hormuz overnight — and Tehran threatens oil and AI facilities across the Gulf if the U.S. and Israel attack again.

stories.title: Flu cases rise on west coast earlier than usual as US health experts encourage vaccine
stories.take: West Coast flu is rising months early — California's test positivity sits at 9.65% versus a normal ~1% for early October, amid a mutated H1N1 strain.

stories.title: New York city council votes to ban horse-drawn carriage rides
stories.take: New York's city council voted to ban horse-drawn carriages by 2028 under Romanch's Law, named for a teen killed in a carriage crash this year.

stories.title: Teacher wounded in Oregon school shooting played dead after she was shot
stories.take: Becky Drury, wounded in last week's Bend, Oregon elementary shooting that killed four, said she was shot before she could intervene and played dead.

stories.title: Massive student-led rally marches in Belgrade ahead of Serbian election
stories.take: About 150,000 supporters marched in Belgrade behind the student-led opposition list ahead of Sunday's pivotal Serbian election against Aleksandar Vučić's party.

stories.title: Macron bans ‘illegitimate’ protests in France as he tries to get a grip on unrest
stories.take: Macron said 'illegitimate' demonstrations will be banned in France as he tries to get a grip on nationwide unrest.

stories.title: America gets new national park with designation of Chiricahua’s rock spires
stories.take: Arizona's Chiricahua — the Land of Standing-Up Rocks — becomes America's newest national park, with bipartisan support.

stories.title: Teenage girl killed at Arcadia home; suspected shooter attempts suicide in Pasadena, police say
stories.take: A teenage girl was killed at an Arcadia home Thursday morning; the suspected shooter later attempted suicide in Pasadena, police say.

stories.title: Supplement sold at gas stations blamed for California man's opioid overdose
stories.take: San Francisco health officials blame a gas-station supplement containing MGM-15, a lab-made form of 7-OH, for a California man's opioid overdose death.

stories.title: Violent winds hit San Clemente just days after destructive wildfire, powerful waves
stories.take: Winds topping 50 mph tore through San Clemente days after a destructive wildfire, snapping trees across a golf course as powerful waves hit the coast.

stories.title: Teen girls listed teacher and student targets for planned Riverside County school shooting, officials say
stories.take: Officials say the two teen girls arrested over a planned Riverside County school shooting had a written list of teacher and student targets, with revenge as the motive.

stories.title: Jurors in Palisades arson retrial may be barred from weighing evidence of LAFD missteps
stories.take: In the Palisades arson retrial, jurors may be barred from weighing evidence of LAFD missteps — a fight over what the defense can argue after the first jury deadlocked.

stories.title: California cities pull the plug on data centers after state regulations don’t scale up fast enough
stories.take: At least 26 California cities have passed or proposed data-center moratoriums or bans since June, even after seven new state laws — local rules are moving faster than Sacramento.

stories.title: Medi-Cal cuts could push seniors and people with disabilities off of coverage
stories.take: A new Medi-Cal asset limit is forcing low-income seniors and people with disabilities to draw down savings to keep coverage, CalMatters reports.

stories.title: Twenty years after California's landmark climate law, the state is not on track to meet its targets
stories.take: Twenty years after its landmark climate law, California is only about halfway to its 2030 emissions goal, the state's latest inventory shows.

stories.title: Rain triggers flooding, erosion concerns across SoCal. Could it stomp out fire season?
stories.take: SoCal rain is triggering flooding and erosion — and three rescues in the Pacoima Wash — but experts say it won't end fire season yet.

stories.title: The peril and promise of presidential power
stories.take: Trump's second term is the imperial presidency expanded: DOJ searching a congresswoman's home, media banned on 'squishy' national-security grounds, deals with Russia that cut against congressional sanctions • The first-term Republican pushback is gone — Kinzinger, Cheney, Romney and Flake replaced by a caucus offering minimal resistance, and Congress has abdicated oversight for ~25 years • Executive orders reverse easily, but the Supreme Court immunity ruling, shifted norms and physical legacy projects (ballroom, triumphal arch) lock in • Bottom line: power tends to expand, not contract — the next presidents, either party, will likely wield more

stories.title: AI Fears Rise Again on Wall Street
stories.take: A tech rout hit Wall Street while Treasury yields posted their biggest drop since 2023, and Brent crude rose 4% to over $113 — its highest since May — on disruption risk even as physical supplies grow • Trump called Musk to lift Starlink speed caps in Ukraine (throttled at ~100 mph, blinding drones); the system is working more normally but not fully restored, and Trump denies ordering the throttle • The Justice Department is reviewing allegations Corey Lewandowski profited from his DHS role by seeking foreign contracts — the first known DOJ scrutiny of a Trump ally this term • Heating with natural gas should be cheaper this winter: more supply, flat demand
